Other names: PALC / 擬似弧長法 Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time. Boundaries: Homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints at x=0 and x=1. Units: Dimensionless. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.
